items.name: Fian Ring
items.lore: A plain silver ring with a running hound. Every fennid of Druim Ligen wears one.

items.name: Border-Watch Belt
items.lore: The Fianna's watch-belt, with a horn-loop and a whetstone pouch.

items.name: Fennid's Torc
items.lore: Twisted bronze, given when a fennid has stood a hundred nights at the gate.

items.name: Gate-Watch Bracer
items.lore: Scarred iron. The gate-watch wear them on the shield arm; the demons go for that one first.

items.name: Mantle of the Rigfennid
items.lore: Green and silver, the mantle of a captain of a fian. Fiachra has one. Now you do.

items.name: Rowan-Friend's Charm
items.lore: Three rowan berries in amber. The groves know whoever carries it.

items.name: Grove-Walker's Bracer
items.lore: Soft leather, dyed with rowan. You walk quieter in it.

items.name: Keeper's Berry Torc
items.lore: Rowan wood, turned and bound with bronze. A Keeper of the Groves wears it.

items.name: Withy-Woven Belt
items.lore: Woven from Irewood withies the Order took back from the Azure carts. Better use for them.

items.name: Mantle of the Rowan
items.lore: Deep green, berried red at the hem. Only a Bandrui or Drui of the Rowan wears it.
